project_name: JEELIVE Rapid Fire — Premium Portrait Game Redesign
archetype: ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC & NEON (Future, Speed, Disruption) mixed with SOFT UTILITY

theme_strategy.game_theme: Teal, Royal Blue, and Purple identity on Near-Black/Graphite surfaces
theme_strategy.rest_app_theme: Retain existing rest-app charcoal/red theme for non-game sections
theme_strategy.orientation: Portrait-only native mobile layout (Expo Android focus)

questions_and_formulas.formula_style: font-mono text-cyan-300 text-lg py-1 px-2 bg-slate-900/80 rounded border border-cyan-500/20

layout_and_grids.mode: Mobile Portrait Hero Grid (1 Column, Stacked Sections)
layout_and_grids.touch_targets: min-h-[48px] rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold px-6 py-4

components.lobby_top_bar: Flex row, justify-between, avatar preview + progression pill left, coin balance pill right
components.emblem_area: Centered glowing 3D-effect energy emblem with pulse animation
components.actions: Primary Play Now (Teal to Royal Blue gradient with elevated shadow) + Challenge Friend (Purple border with royal blue glow)
components.card_face: Near-black #12141C card with 1px border border-teal-500/30, subtle radial glow backdrop, 20-second circular progress timer at top right

visual_enhancers.card_depth: Subtle 1px border stroke with 10% opacity, layered ambient drop shadows, soft cyan/violet rim lighting
visual_enhancers.emblems_and_badges: Cohesive dimensional energy emblems for Play Now, Duel, Coins, and Trophies

motion.button_press: Scale down to 0.96 on active press with quick spring response
motion.reduced_motion: Honors prefers-reduced-motion by replacing smooth slides with instant opacity fades

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.
Do NOT alter global rest-app themes (charcoal/red) outside of the Rapid Fire mobile game section.
Retain existing 30 cards format and 20-second timer per card.
Keep visible real coin counters in top player bar, shop, and results screens.
Implement one-tap Friends Fight history modal/drawer from lobby.
Ensure high contrast on dark graphite cards for formulas and text legibility.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: WCAG AA contrast for text (min 4.5:1), touch targets min 48px
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All key elements must have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='play-now-button', data-testid='coin-balance')
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.fonts_rule: Use rounded expressive headings for game elements, clean mono/sans for formulas
